intent: An editable table: people click a cell to add or change its content, like rule conditions, line items, or mappings.
useWhen: People build or change rows in place: rule conditions, price tiers, field mappings, line items
Short editable lists where a form per row would be slow
doNotUseWhen: Short read-only text rows — use Table
Searchable, filterable datasets people read and select — use DataTable
A form of Fields and Inputs per row

columns.note: type defaults to text. select needs options. date is kit DatePicker; value is YYYY-MM-DD. Do not add type formula — this kit has no FormulaEditor; stop and ask.

rows.note: Controlled rows, one string per column key. Save with onRowsChange. Do not wrap the grid in Form.

defaultRows.note: Starting rows when rows is not controlled.

onRowsChange.note: (rows: DataGridRow[]) => void. Runs when a cell is saved and when rows are added or removed.

label.note: Accessible name for the table, and each cell, like Value, row 2.

size.note: Passed to HeaderCell. Edit controls are size sm.

canAddRows.note: Add row button under the grid. Not primary. New row starts empty; first cell opens for editing.

canRemoveRows.note: Remove control at the end of each row. Named in a kit Tooltip.

emptyLabel.note: Shown in one td with colSpan when there are no rows.

rowNumbers.note: A # column with each row's number.

stickyFirstColumn.note: The # column (if shown) and the first data column stay in place while the grid scrolls sideways.

requirements: Native table named by label, with kit HeaderCell headers and th scope=col
Each idle text cell is a button named by its column and row with its value, like Value, row 2: 100
Select and date columns always show the kit Select or DatePicker in the cell so the grid does not shift when the value changes
Enter or click on a text cell opens a kit Input named the same way, inset in the cell, and focus moves into it
Enter saves and Escape cancels; focus goes back to the cell. Tab moves to the next cell
Remove row buttons are named Remove row 2 and show that in a Tooltip
A date cell editor is a kit DatePicker named by its column and row, like Start date, row 2
Empty state is one td with colSpan and emptyLabel
Narrow container keeps column min-width and scrolls horizontally; the scroller is a focusable region

doNot: Do not invent EditableCell, GridRow, or a table of loose Inputs. Pass columns with a type.
Do not wrap the grid in Form. Save the rows from onRowsChange.
Search, filters, column settings, sort, or bulk selection — use DataTable
Short read-only text rows — use Table
Do not use Cell for editable body cells — Cell is display content for DataTable
Do not add type formula. This kit has no FormulaEditor. Stop and ask.
Do not add Density, expandable row detail, or a primary Add row Button
snippet:
<DataGrid
  label="Conditions"
  columns={[
    { key: "field", header: "Field" },
    { key: "condition", header: "Condition", type: "select", options: conditions, width: "12rem" },
    { key: "value", header: "Value" },
  ]}
  rows={rules}
  onRowsChange={setRules}
  canAddRows
  canRemoveRows
/>
